meta.name: docs-seeker
meta.description: Searching internet for technical documentation using llms.txt standard, GitHub repositories via Repomix, and parallel exploration. Use when user needs: (1) Latest documentation for libraries/frameworks, (2) Documentation in llms.txt format, (3) GitHub repository analysis, (4) Documentation without direct llms.txt support, (5) Multiple documentation sources in parallel

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索技术文档和GitHub仓库，快速获取最新资料
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查找框架文档或分析GitHub仓库
copy.tagline_en: Search technical docs and GitHub repos for the latest info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find framework docs or analyze GitHub repos

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会主动搜索技术文档，优先找 llms.txt 格式的文档，找不到就分析 GitHub 仓库或并行搜索多个来源，最后汇总成一份结构化报告。
howto.when: 当你询问某个库或框架的最新文档、需要 llms.txt 格式的文档、分析 GitHub 仓库、或需要同时查阅多个文档来源时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一下 Next.js 的最新文档。
分析一下这个 GitHub 仓库的文档结构。
say.note: Claude 会使用 Repomix 打包仓库并提取文档。

say.text: 同时查一下 Astro 和 Remix 的文档。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will actively search for technical documentation, prioritizing llms.txt format, then analyze GitHub repositories or explore multiple sources in parallel, and finally produce a consolidated report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for the latest documentation of a library/framework, need llms.txt format docs, want GitHub repository analysis, or require multiple documentation sources simultaneously.

say_en.text: Find the latest documentation for Next.js.
say_en.note: Claude will prioritize fetching llms.txt from context7.com.

say_en.text: Analyze the documentation structure of this GitHub repo.
say_en.note: Claude will use Repomix to pack the repo and extract docs.

say_en.text: Look up docs for both Astro and Remix at the same time.
say_en.note: Claude will launch multiple Explorer agents in parallel.
